sentences.text: Partha Pratim Pal vs Unknown on 17 October, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
17.10.2023 In The High Court At Calcutta Item No.126 Criminal Revisional
Jurisdiction Ct.No.34 dc.
C.R.R. 3960 of 2023
In the matter of : Partha Pratim Pal ... Petitioner.

Mr. Angshuman
Chakraborty, Mr. S. S. Saha ...

The petitioner is directed to serve copy of this revisional application upon the opposite party
no.1/State through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon the
opposite party no.2 by Speed Post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the
next date fixed for hearing.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has lodged complaint
earlier and the lady has suo motu left the residence and initiated the instant case on the basis of
which charge-sheet was submitted in connection with Deganga Police Station Case No. 100 of 2023
dated 06.03.2023 under Sections 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code.
Having regard to such factum that the statements do support the contention of the lady, I am not
inclined to pass interim order at this stage.
List the revisional application under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of January 2024.
All concerned parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
